title: In multiple functions in multiple locations, there is a possible execution of sensitive USSD codes… (CVE-2026-55289)
description: CVE-2026-55289 is a vulnerability involving the possible execution of sensitive USSD codes in multiple functions and locations due to a confused deputy issue. This flaw allows local escalation of privilege without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 8.4, indicating significant impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
